about: Shared cases for Proofread and the extra fact checks (rounds 20 and 21). Written by the browser simulation with its clock fixed at Jul 16, 2026 and the fictional demo records. A port to the Windows app or the extension must give the same answers.

proofread.corrected: Hi all, quick status. ANDA 216482 is on track, with a goal date of Oct 10, 2026 and a forecast of Oct 17, 2026. ANDA 214990 is running late. ANDA 123456 needs a call. The IR response for ANDA 216482 (750 mg, cycle 3) is due Jul 28.

differences: ANDA 216482: the draft says 750 mg, but your data says Metformin HCl ER Tablets, 500 mg.
ANDA 216482: the draft says cycle 3, but your data says cycle 2.
ANDA 216482: the draft gives a due date of Jul 28, but your data says the IR response is due Jul 21, 2026.
